title: Your Raise Disappeared. Here's Why.
hook: Lifestyle creep eats a raise faster than tax does.
question: Did your last raise disappear?

sources.name: Hedonic treadmill (Wikipedia)
sources.quote: humans quickly return to a relatively stable level of happiness

sources.name: Keeping up with the Joneses (Wikipedia)
sources.quote: the comparison of oneself to one's neighbor

scenes.narration: You finally landed a raise. Six months later, it has somehow completely vanished. And no, tax is not the main reason.
The real culprit is lifestyle creep. A bigger paycheck quietly turns into a bigger apartment, a nicer car, and more subscriptions.
It is a well-documented pattern where former luxuries become perceived necessities.
Psychologists call the underlying trap a hedonic treadmill. You adapt, then you want more.
And a lot of it is just quietly keeping up with the neighbors.

shots.kicker: Wikipedia · keeping up with the Joneses

scenes.narration: So a twenty thousand dollar raise can easily end up as only two thousand dollars actually saved.
Be honest. Did your last raise quietly disappear just like that?
